Title: 2018-10-08 PTR Patch
Subtitle: === Battlegrounds: Garden of Terror ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Garden of Terror ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where all three Garden Terrors could spawn in a single lane.

=== Heroes: Alexstrasza ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Gift of Life (Q)
    • Minions and Mercenaries are no longer valid targets.
  • Dragonqueen: Breath of Life (Q)
    • Minions and Mercenaries are no longer valid targets.

=== Heroes: Ana ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Healing Dart (Q)
    • Healing Dart will now pierce targets at full Health.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where Ana's Shrike healing was not accurately reflecting her damage done (via Spell Power or her target's Armor).

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Pixie Dust (E)
    • Minions and Mercenaries are no longer valid targets.

=== Heroes: Chromie ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where Temporal Loop's return location would appear incorrect if a movement ability was used by the target.

=== Heroes: Diablo ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where Diablo would not be displaced by knockback and similar effects while casting Overpower.

=== Heroes: Gall ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where not all cases of Damage Reduction would work on Gall.

=== Heroes: Gul'dan ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where Darkness Within's bonus Spell Power would not increase the healing of Drain Life.

=== Heroes: Kharazim ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can now Radiant Dash to all allied units, including Mercenaries, Creep Tumors, and Toxic Nests.

=== Heroes: Li Li ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Healing Brew (Q)
    • Minions and Mercenaries are no longer valid targets.

=== Heroes: Li-Ming ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where Tal'Rasha's Elements would grant bonus damage to Calamity after being twice in a row.

=== Heroes: Mal'Ganis ===
[Releases]
  Mal'Ganis, Nathrezim Lord, has been added to the Nexus and is now available for play! Read on for a brief overview of his Abilities.:
  Trait:
  • Vampiric Touch
    • Mal'Ganis heals for 45% of damage dealt to enemy Heroes and 15% of damage dealt to non-Heroes.
  Basic Abilities:
  • Fel Claws (Q)
    • Violently slash in the chosen direction, dealing 78 damage to enemies.
    • Reactivate to slash up to 2 more times. The third slash Stuns enemies for 0.75 seconds.
  • Necrotic Embrace (W)
    • Desecrate the air, dealing 119 damage to nearby enemies and gaining 25 Armor for 3 seconds.
  • Night Rush (E)
    • After 0.75 seconds, gain 50% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. While active, Mal'Ganis can move through enemy Heroes and put them to Sleep for 2.5 seconds.
  Heroic Abilities:
  • Carrion Swarm (R)
    • After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 74 damage per second to enemies.
    • Vampiric Touch heals for 100% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.
  • Dark Conversion (R)
    • Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Egg Hunt's Slime no longer benefits from Slime talents.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 4
    • Healing Totem (Active)
      • Minions and Mercenaries are no longer valid targets.
  • Level 13
    • Earth Shield (W)
      • Minions and Mercenaries are no longer valid targets.

=== Heroes: Sylvanas ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Targets of Mind Control will now clear their move orders when affected by the ability.

=== Heroes: Tyrande ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Light of Elune (Q)
    • Minions and Mercenaries are no longer valid targets.

=== Heroes: Uther ===
[Updates]
  Abilities:
  • Holy Light (Q)
    • Minions and Mercenaries are no longer valid targets.
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue where Holy Fire's damage was affected by Spell Power.
